Notes
*1 Internet origin does not mean public access
Block Public Access is always enabled and cannot be disabled; every request requires IAM authentication and authorization
*2 Concurrent multi-protocol access
The same data stays reachable over NFS / SMB / S3 API at once, with no data migration
